$comment: Mutations accepted as alive, each with a reason and, where the work is bigger than a patch, a ledger id. A survivor with no entry fails the release. This is not a place to make a finding go away — an entry is a debt with an address. Keyed on the SOURCE LINE, never its number: a line-numbered waiver stops matching when anything above it moves, and then silently waives a different mutation.
